features.description: Ingestion chunks, embeds and indexes the corpus reproducibly (FR-ING-*, docs/spec/features/ingestion.feature)
steps: bash scripts/check.sh runs the @unit scenarios of ingestion.feature and they pass
The planted injection payload survives chunking intact (tests/test_chunking.py)

features.description: The query API answers with citations and maps errors to its contract (FR-API-*, docs/spec/features/query_api.feature)
steps: bash scripts/check.sh runs the @unit scenarios of query_api.feature and they pass
A missing or blank question returns 400, not 422

features.description: Answers are grounded, context is fenced and a question below the similarity floor is refused without a model call (docs/spec/features/grounding_and_injection.feature)
steps: bash scripts/check.sh runs the @unit scenarios of grounding_and_injection.feature and they pass

features.description: Configuration is validated at startup and logs are structured without secrets or answers (FR-CFG-*, FR-LOG-*, docs/spec/features/config_and_runtime.feature)
steps: bash scripts/check.sh runs the @unit scenarios of config_and_runtime.feature and they pass

features.description: The Streamlit page renders answers, sources-only answers, refusals and errors from the API
steps: bash scripts/check.sh runs the ui-tests service and it passes

features.description: Real model behaviour: exact figures, refusal of out-of-corpus questions, resistance to the planted injection (the @live tier; the closest thing to a golden set, there is no eval harness)
steps: With the human: docker compose up -d && docker compose run --rm ingest
With the human: GEMINI_API_KEY=... API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 pytest -m live passes

features.description: Compose startup, dependency ordering, volume persistence and a non-root image (the @docker tier)
steps: On a host with Python and Docker: pytest -m docker passes, or the commands in SPEC.md section 11.4 give the stated results
